subject: general
question: D is the son of E. M is the husband of E. A is the mother of E. A is married to T. How is T related to D?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5baedeeb828b193ad2f892fd05c869fc9547486db9c55fff996dd4ad1389228.png] 

As per the given information, the family tree diagram:

1. D is the son of E and M is the husband of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/934f97caa9a8af23b95946d362658cdf580703ad9851bdb843ce229bd62db0a9.png] 

2. A is the mother of E and T is the husband of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/264ec02b822275256680120e7312ae969493d40af635de6b2d67859337fba6b7.png] 

Here, T is the father of D's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
